name: business-agent
description: An agentic assistant over a small consulting business's records: reads clients, projects, invoices and time entries, proposes writes for per-action approval, and is measured by a mechanical eval suite.

scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait
scripts.db:check: docker compose exec -T db psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U business_agent -d business_agent -f /dev/stdin < scripts/assert-roles.sql

//optionalDependencies: Only the bedrock provider imports this, and it does so with a dynamic import, so the default anthropic path never loads it. Optional rather than a plain dependency because an install that pulls an AWS SDK to talk to api.anthropic.com invites the reasonable question of what else is being sent where.
